messages.author: 505f87eeb7607479
messages.subject: drop levels when plotting
parts:
Hi,
Is there a way to drop unused levels when using ggplot?

nyc <- city_density[name="New York",]
ggplot(nyc, aes(population, area, group="district")) + geom_line(); #
I get all districts for all cities in x-axis, even though only those
in NY have values

Now I'm using gdata's drop.levels, but I thought there might be a
better way.

Thanks,

Nacho
